fallbackFaqItems.question: Are the products genuine?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Yes. Products sold are original Herbal Kapıda Nutrition products. This site belongs to an independent distributor; not the official Herbal Kapıda site.

fallbackFaqItems.question: How long does shipping take?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: After payment confirmation, orders usually ship within 1–3 business days. We share the tracking code in your notification.

fallbackFaqItems.question: How can I pay?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Card payments use the secure PayTR infrastructure. There is no cash on delivery. Apply coupon codes at checkout if you have one.

fallbackFaqItems.question: Do I have a right of withdrawal?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Distance sales include a 14-day withdrawal right. See Returns & cancellation; apply with your order number.

fallbackFaqItems.question: What is nutrition tracking?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: Log water, meals, and measurements in your account; your coach can approve and support you.

fallbackFaqItems.question: Which bundle should I choose?
fallbackFaqItems.answer: We offer gift bundles for your goal. Product advice is available on WhatsApp — typical reply under one hour.

fallbackItems.question: Les produits sont-ils authentiques ?
fallbackItems.answer: Oui. Les produits vendus sont des produits Herbal Kapıda d'origine. Ce site appartient à un distributeur indépendant Herbal Kapıda Nutrition.

fallbackItems.question: Quel coffret dois-je choisir ?
fallbackItems.answer: Nous proposons des coffrets selon votre objectif (gestion du poids, sport, bien-être). Demandez un conseil gratuit sur WhatsApp.

fallbackItems.question: Quels sont les délais de livraison ?
fallbackItems.answer: Les commandes sont généralement expédiées sous 1–2 jours ouvrés. Le délai dépend du transporteur et de votre région.

fallbackItems.question: Puis-je retourner un produit ?
fallbackItems.answer: Oui, dans le cadre du droit de rétractation et de notre politique de retour. Consultez les pages légales ou contactez-nous.
